hints.title: Reverse Thinking
hints.text: Instead of building nums from zeros, consider reducing nums to zeros using decrements (individual) and divisions by 2 (shared).

hints.title: Counting Add Operations
hints.text: Every set bit 1 in any number in nums requires exactly one increment operation.

hints.title: Counting Multiply Operations
hints.text: A division by 2 halves every number simultaneously. The number of doubling operations required is the maximum bit length minus 1 over all numbers.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating operation by operation on large numbers causes slow repeated array loops.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inspecting binary bit representations takes O(1) per integer, totaling O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that additions equal total set bits and multiplications equal max bit length.
